snippet.title: Femboy Fury // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134710/Femboy_Fury/

Femboy Fury is a demolition derby of high-octane proportions! Choose between 10 femboy characters and compete in an arcade like drive-and-shoot in semi-destructible environments! Franticly search for weapon pick-ups as you dodge enemies chasing you! Be the last femboy driving in 8 levels!

Developed by
FzzyBzzy aka @FzzyBzzy
